Subject: FW: Ethan Cole — full loop availability (dual-track proposal)

Forwarding Ethan's availability from Acme Talent and drafting a proposal to minimize candidate fatigue while keeping robust evaluation across areas. Ethan is in PST. Recruiter attached resume and his calendar windows.

Proposed approach (short):
- Run two parallel 45-min tracks to shorten total time; each track has 1 interviewer + 1 deep-dive.
  - Track A (technical): coding (45) + systems design (45)
  - Track B (product/culture): product sense (45) + behavioral/culture (30)
- 30-min buffer between tracks for KV-cache warmups + logistics (candidate breaks).
- Final debrief: 30 min immediately after Candidate block; I propose Markus to moderate, Karthik to take notes for technical, Laura to own product/culture scoring.

Questions for the group:
1) Can each of you confirm ownership for the slots above?
2) Any conflicts with Tuesday 12/15 or Wednesday 12/16 PST windows below?

Ethan's availability (from recruiter): 12/15 09:30-14:30 PST or 12/16 10:00-15:00 PST. Recruiter suggested we compress into a 3.5h window if possible.

Attachments: resume_ethan_cole.pdf, parallel_track_calendar.ics

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
